_comment: Anchor definitions for blind ncRNA discovery. PROTEIN MODELS ONLY.
No model describing a guide nucleic acid may appear here: no RNA family
accessions, no repeat consensus, no length or fold rule for any known
guide, no annotation of a known scaffold RNA. Adding one breaks the blind
and invalidates every ground-truth control. Benchmark material lives in
configs/known_retron/ and data/known_retrons/, which no code reachable
`priority` resolves ORFs that hit several families. A group II intron
maturase hits GIIM *and* RVT_1; the specific family must win, otherwise
the assignment depends on which domain happened to score higher. Higher
number wins; score breaks ties within a priority level.

GroupII_RT.description: Group II intron maturase. RT whose partner RNA is the intron itself — a natural RT+RNA blind test.

RT.description: Reverse transcriptase catalytic core, generic. Retron RT falls here. min_aa_len 250: RVT_3 otherwise pulls in a 138 aa host protein present in 10,784 identical copies.

IS110.description: IS110/IS1111 transposase. Bridge-RNA-guided; RNA itself not modelled.

Cas9.description: Cas9 protein domains only. Census: 236 anchors, 17 nr90 over 2 species -- too thin for an in-corpus control, but still scanned.

Cas13.description: Cas13a effectors. Cas13-specific models only; a bare HEPN domain is far too generic to anchor on. Census: zero hits in this corpus.

Cas3.description: Type I Cas3 nuclease/helicase. Verified: 92.4% of census anchors have cascade genes within 10 kb, so the HD-clan promiscuity concern does not apply here.

TnpB_Cas12f.description: TnpB / Cas12f lineage. PF07282 is the TnpB TNB domain: census hits are 402 aa median, ~2 copies per genome -- IS200/IS605 TnpB, which Cas12f descends from. TnpB is omegaRNA-guided, so this is a strong anchor, but it must not be labelled Cas12.

Cas12.description: True Cas12/Cpf1 effectors, kept separate from the TnpB lineage. 1 census hit.

thresholds._comment: Pfam gathering thresholds (--cut_ga) gate first; these are extra guards. A family may set min_aa_len to override the global one, applied after family assignment.
